kinprove-genealogy-research-recipes-gene.description: Genealogy/DNA research: unknown parentage and WATO; endogamy, family comparisons, Y/mt/X DNA, phasing, admixture, cross-vendor controls, DNA match messages; documentary identity, conditional hypotheses, GPS audits; index vs original records (FreeBMD/GRO, Find a Grave), archival image/transcript coverage, Ukrainian Jewish-list triage, ELIB guides; Jewish-name/OCR searches; Russian-Empire names, registration, emigrant origins, military records; Soviet repression and 1944 deportations; Holocaust testimony. Ancestry, MyHeritage, FamilySearch, JewishGen, HebrewBooks, 23andMe, FTDNA, GEDmatch, DNA…
